extension.summary: Manage Wi-Fi and Bluetooth inside Kodi
Gerencia Wi-Fi e Bluetooth dentro do Kodi
extension.description: Kodi has no radio manager on Linux, so this add-on drives NetworkManager (nmcli) and BlueZ (bluetoothctl) directly: scan and join Wi-Fi networks, list/pair/connect Bluetooth devices. Installed by the Walkmam RK3566 image.

O Kodi nao tem gerenciador de radio no Linux, entao este add-on fala direto com o NetworkManager (nmcli) e o BlueZ (bluetoothctl): procurar e conectar redes Wi-Fi, listar/parear/conectar dispositivos Bluetooth. Faz parte da imagem Walkmam RK3566.
